0 findings; 0 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

I found nothing to flag in this part. `TagEditor` now builds each edit on a ref that tracks the latest list sent. A pasted list ends in a single `onAssign` call. Tags are only created while they still fit under the per-item cap. The ref re-syncs with the props once all saves settle. Both callers now return the `setTags` promise, and `setTags` catches and reports its own errors (`use-local-library.ts:77-86`), so the `.finally` in `commit` is never given a rejection. The new tests cover the paste, cap, quick-removal and re-sync cases. I did not run the test suite. The docs changes are consistent with the plan file's removal.
